title: Recheck a delegation's worktree between follow-up admission and the turn's dispatch
outcome: A follow-up admitted while its delegation's worktree was present does not start a runtime in that worktree if a person removed it between admission and the turn's dispatch; the turn is refused with the same reason as at admission.
acceptance: Between follow-up admission and dispatch of the follow-up turn, the delegation's worktree owner check runs again; if the worktree is gone or no longer this delegation's own, the turn is not dispatched and the delegation reports the refusal reason. Shown by a behavioral test that removes the worktree after admission.
